timingRules: Every baseline receipt must be demonstrably public before the rating-event decision cutoff.
Same-date data with unresolved publication ordering remains UNKNOWN and blocks freezing.
Later financial statements, restatements, revised macro vintages and later rating actions never backfill an earlier anchor.
missingnessRules: Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN; never coerce to zero, neutral, BAD, pass or no deterioration.
D22-06 market-credit state is optional only as preregistered when genuinely unavailable; its absence cannot be encoded as zero spread.
independenceRules: Use only the first directional event date of each frozen episode as the independent challenger anchor.
Later same-direction actions update episode state but do not create another independent pair.
freezeGate: All required B0 receipts satisfy knownAt cutoff.

outcomeGate: CLOSED until at least 20 mature independent pairs are frozen under this contract; reaching 20 permits the next gate only and does not imply L4.
next: Materialize receipt rows for the 22 frozen anchors without return labels.
